pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #16
====

GRADE: Grade 6
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which response best shows understanding of Tawakkul? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Tawakkul with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Tawakkul.
   C. Say Tawakkul has no place in daily life.
   D. Use Tawakkul to insult classmates of other faiths.

2. Respect in religious education is shown by: (1 mark)
   A. Skipping all moral lessons
   B. Mocking other people’s beliefs
   C. Listening to others and living values taught at home and school
   D. Refusing to help a neighbour

3. Which response best shows understanding of Hajj? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hajj has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hajj to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Hajj with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hajj.

4. Which response best shows understanding of Taqwa? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Taqwa.
   B. Say Taqwa has no place in daily life.
   C. Use Taqwa to insult classmates of other faiths.
   D. Apply the teaching of Taqwa with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

5. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources? (1 mark)
   A. Apply the teaching of Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   B. Say Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources has no place in daily life.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources.
   D. Use Hadith on responsible use of human capabilities and resources to insult classmates of other faiths.

6. Which response best shows understanding of Twahara? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Twahara.
   B. Say Twahara has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Twahara with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Use Twahara to insult classmates of other faiths.

7. Honesty means: (1 mark)
   A. Telling the truth and keeping trust
   B. Cheating in exams
   C. Hiding stolen items
   D. Spreading rumours

8. Which response best shows understanding of Saum? (1 mark)
   A. Say Saum has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Saum to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Apply the teaching of Saum with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Saum.

9. A good steward of creation should: (1 mark)
   A. Pollute rivers deliberately
   B. Waste food daily
   C. Destroy trees without planting
   D. Care for the environment and use resources wisely

10. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on Purity of Actions? (1 mark)
   A. Say Hadith on Purity of Actions has no place in daily life.
   B. Use Hadith on Purity of Actions to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on Purity of Actions.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on Purity of Actions with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

11. Which response best shows understanding of Hadith on planting? (1 mark)
   A. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Hadith on planting.
   B. Use Hadith on planting to insult classmates of other faiths.
   C. Say Hadith on planting has no place in daily life.
   D. Apply the teaching of Hadith on planting with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.

12. Which response best shows understanding of Stories of Prophets:? (1 mark)
   A. Use Stories of Prophets: to insult classmates of other faiths.
   B. Say Stories of Prophets: has no place in daily life.
   C. Apply the teaching of Stories of Prophets: with respect, honesty, and care for others in Kenya.
   D. Ignore safety and kindness while discussing Stories of Prophets:.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fair treatment of workers 03 6.2 Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Relationship with people of other faiths 03 6.3 Corruption 04 7 History of Islam and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Relations with people of other faiths and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Corruption 04 7 History of Islam 7.1 Battle of Badr and Uhud 04 7.2 Treaty of Hu and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
